overview.short: Khurnak Fort is a historical ruined frontier fortress on the northern shore of high-altitude Pangong Lake in eastern Ladakh at 4,250m elevation.
overview.description: Khurnak Fort (Tibetan: མཁར་ནག, Wylie: mkhar nag) is a historic ruined fort on the northern shore of Pangong Lake at 4,250 m elevation. Denoting the geographic middle boundary of the Pangong basin in eastern Ladakh, the fort stands on the alluvial fan of the Changlung Lungpa river overlooking crystalline turquoise waters and the barren, majestic ridges of the Changchenmo mountain range.

topPlaces.name: Pangong Tso (North Shore Waters)
topPlaces.description: The famed endorheic high-altitude salt lake situated at 4,225m. The crystal waters shift dramatically between cobalt blue and turquoise, bordered by the jagged arid peaks of the Changchenmo range.

topPlaces.name: Changlung Lungpa Plain & Ruined Ramparts
topPlaces.description: The broad alluvial mountain plain where glacial meltwaters flow toward Pangong Lake. Features historical dry-stone fortification walls, ancient trader campsites, and panoramic Changthang desert expanses.
topPlaces.travelTime: Under 10 mins walk from lake edge

items.note: Pangong Tso or Pangong Lake (Tibetan: སྤང་གོང་མཚོ; Chinese: 班公错; pinyin: Bān gōng cuò) is an endorheic lake spanning eastern Ladakh and West Tibet situated at an elevation of 4,225 m (13,862 ft). It is 134 km (83 mi) long.

faq.q: What is Khurnak Fort and where is it located?
faq.a: Khurnak Fort is a historical ruined border fort located on the northern shore of Pangong Lake at 4,250 meters altitude in eastern Ladakh, situated on the alluvial fan of the Changlung Lungpa river.

faq.q: What is the best time to visit Pangong Lake and eastern Ladakh?
faq.a: The best time to visit is from May to September when mountain passes like Chang La are open and temperatures range between 12°C and 25°C.

faq.q: Are permits required to travel to the Pangong Tso region?
faq.a: Yes, an Inner Line Permit (ILP) or Protected Area Permit (PAP) from the Ladakh District Administration in Leh is mandatory for Indian and foreign travelers visiting Pangong Tso and Changthang.

faq.q: What are the top attractions near Khurnak Fort?
faq.a: Top attractions include the crystalline turquoise waters of Pangong Tso, the Changlung Lungpa alluvial mountain plain, and the panoramic Himalayan viewpoints along the lake.
